createStructuredNotesActionDefinitionV1 and original attempt builders invoked by coordinator

entrypoint_finding.qualification_app_runtime_entry: Model-free SuperBox/persistence fixture that calls serveAppRuntime and uses fixture provider/model and different outputs. Read as a reference only; importing/running it is unsuitable for six real phone attempts.
entrypoint_finding.serviceAttemptPort: Original App adapter borrows desktop credentials using AuthService.withCredential and exports a credential envelope into SuperBox. Not reused; no desktop credential access is needed or allowed.
entrypoint_finding.injection_point: TahFrameworkAttemptPortV1.run(BuiltAttemptV1, onEvent?, signal?) -> Promise<TahAttemptResultV1>; replace transport here while leaving the original coordinator and durable publisher intact.
entrypoint_finding.persistence_point: Required original JournalPort.read/append with actual atomic durable storage/version semantics, supplied by main. Original DurableTahPersistence replays its validators; this skeleton supplies no storage implementation.

outbound_fields: attemptJSON: JSON.stringify(original validated FrozenAttemptV1), UTF-8 exact bytes
attemptSHA256: lowercase SHA256 of those exact UTF-8 bytes
inputFiles: canonical relativePath/base64 pairs for every material and file seed, no extras
draft_wire_alignment.validation: Original parseFrozenAttempt validates contract/paths/role. Each input must match original byteLength/sha256; directory seeds stay in attemptJSON only. Phone must repeat all checks before installing immutable views.
draft_wire_alignment.inbound_file: Documents/inbound-attempt.json outside model-visible workspace; not written by this skeleton.
draft_wire_alignment.app_invocation: Main-owned --run-tah-attempt, one real attempt per fresh App process. No devicectl/pymobiledevice3 implementation or launch here.
do_not_send_to_model: PhoneRequest host binding and run context

phone_admission_fields_required.identity: Real accountFingerprint = SHA256(actual same-App OAuth accountID), observed before releasing each model turn and bound to the final receipt; never raw accountID/email/token. Compare against initial expected fingerprint. Token refresh is not by itself an account change. A fingerprint is identifying metadata, not a credential or cryptographic proof of phone origin.
phone_admission_fields_required.catalog: Actual model IDs/effort handles and selection receipts; map to original catalogSchema without invented/default placeholders. Preserve exact requested/accepted model and effort, null native-default semantics, no fallback and no fake CodeModeOnly metadata.
phone_admission_fields_required.authorization: A real current completed successful inspection, not synthesized state=valid. Original authorizationCheckSucceeded requires valid/idle, not inspecting, no replacement, succeeded inspection, finishedAt and zero failures. Original inspectionFailures additionally requires nonempty catalog and usable account usage. Fingerprint+catalog alone does not establish that App admission receipt.
phone_admission_fields_required.profile: Trusted host profileDigest over the frozen qualification policy/config plus source/asset identity; not an arbitrary constant supplied as proof. Scope/attempt/material/seed digests must bind to actual installed views.
phone_admission_fields_required.attempt: Host run/challenge identity, fresh attemptID, exact attemptSHA256, actual threadID/turnID, final selected model/effort and authoritative completed status. Reject stale/replayed/cross-attempt outputs.
phone_admission_fields_required.process: Host records launch PID plus unique process/launch identity (PID alone can be reused), and independently observes that exact process has exited. Phone JSON exited=true is insufficient; no next attempt starts while cleanup is uncertain.
phone_admission_fields_required.events: Real normalized lifecycle events reconciled with canonical Rust messages and actual authoritative turn completion. Original NormalizedEventLedgerV1 checks sequence, lifecycle and final-text equality. It does not authenticate a fabricated event stream.
phone_admission_fields_required.files: Exact snapshot manifest and bytes with lengths/digests, regular-file/no-link scope validation, no extra paths, immutable inputs/history verification, and confirmed final snapshot after execution stopped. Guardian candidate set must be empty. Host quarantine precedes framework admission.
phone_admission_fields_required.result: Only trusted external admitReaped may return TahAttemptResultV1 {terminal,candidateManifest,candidateFiles}. Do not invent accepted/publication receipts in phone JSON. Original framework decides Guardian/critic acceptance and original persistence creates real commit receipts.

bounded_sequence.six_attempt_cap: An unexpected role (including structural repair) is refused in this fixed six-attempt lane; original framework handles the stopped attempt and never publishes a rejected candidate. This is explicitly narrower than the fixture pack's optional nine-attempt repair lane.
bounded_sequence.per_attempt: External runFresh must enforce immutable per-role views and OS teardown. Before each submission inspect expected account/catalog/profile; recheck inside fresh process and receipt admission.
bounded_sequence.failure: Any run/admission exception locks further work. No auto-relaunch or infrastructure retry. Aborting/timing out does not itself prove OS exit.
bounded_sequence.host_lifetime: One live host invocation across fresh phone processes; host crash resume and App raw-safety cache are unimplemented. Existing journal can persist original transitions but this entry does not invent a resume algorithm.

blocking_fields_or_ports: Trusted phone inspect/runFresh/admitReaped implementations are absent and throw by default.

Current proposed accountFingerprint+catalog payload still lacks original App successful-inspection/usable-usage evidence. Do not fabricate an AuthSnapshot; either supply actual evidence or explicitly design/document a narrower qualification admission contract separately.
Durable JournalPort with atomic append/version/recovery is required; no placeholder success is allowed.
Exact process-identity/PID-gone evidence and digest-bound immutable scope/candidate receipts must be specified in the final main-owned wire.
Actual Guardian gpt-5.6-luna/low and selected Actor availability must pass; code does not substitute the phone default.

validation.actual_scope: Original source functions loaded by existing local Vitest. Synthetic fixture projection, exact bytes/hash/map, V0 empty-seed/ledger, missing V1 seed rejection, closed Guardian parser rejection, dummy identity/catalog checks, and unwired-port failure. No fake successful workflow or phone receipt tested.

handoff: Implement the two trusted ports, freeze wire after resolving blocking fields, then explicitly invoke runQualification(actorInference, phonePort, journalPort, signal). Read README.md. No automatic phone work on import.
